title: Graders read the agent's worktrees and branches
goal: An agent that follows AGENTS.md (worktree, branch, push) is graded on what it did
acceptance: Failing-first fixture tests: work in another worktree, on a local branch or on a pushed branch is graded there; with several changed views each is graded and all must pass
Patch release after a confirmed merge
privacy: Tool text only; fixtures are invented; no personal data.
escalation: Running real agents is the owner's runner, never CI

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 at agent speed: candidate views in grade(), fixture tests and a patch release. Not a measurement. Implemented 2026-11-25 for 10.15.2 (failing-first test committed before the fix); review, CI and tag remain. Released in v10.15.2 (#275; main CI green on 66b4470 confirmed before tagging). Closed 2026-11-25.
